Resources use SDK read_resource with bounded body, original local settings authority revalidation, per-request cancellation and sandbox/no-store/nosniff. staticConclusions.subject: OAuth ownership and saved facts
staticConclusions.finding: Start/callback retain original SettingsAuthority, flow epoch, credential epoch and connector identity; writes use existing Source/FileSafety and precommit validation. Logout bumps lifecycle counters and clears Source before cleanup; callback poll distinguishes confirmed credentials from unconfirmed finalization. These are not actual new remote function test passes.

newStaticRisks.location: mcp_oauth.rs credential_identity, ConnectorStore::checked/write, start and complete
newStaticRisks.finding: Credential identity excludes oauth.sdk. A new login writes replacement SDK credentials without advancing oauth_credential_epochs. Existing runtime refresh store and another already-created flow can therefore retain the same epoch and connector identity. complete stops the prior runtime only after the credential write, leaving a late old credential writer path that needs a real interleaving check.
newStaticRisks.sdkSupport: Locked rmcp 3.4.1 refresh_token loads credentials, awaits actual token response, then saves through CredentialStore. The refresh mutex is per StoreInner, not shared by a different login flow.
newStaticRisks.minimalCheck: Hold an old real refresh response while a new actual OAuth login saves distinguishable credentials, release old refresh, and assert new Source credentials do not revert/clear. Alternatively two preregistered-client login callbacks B then A demonstrate whether stale login intent is rejected; define that intended ordering explicitly.
newStaticRisks.minimalFixDirection: Bind saved credentials to an issuance generation or coordinate refresh/login writers; do not reject ordinary valid SDK refreshes or erase saved/unknown facts.

newStaticRisks.location: mcp_oauth.rs start flow retention/FLOW_LIMIT and cancel_flow
newStaticRisks.finding: The 32-item waiting limit counts done/error/cancelled entries retained for 300 seconds. Cancellation does not release a waiting slot although the limit error instructs the user to cancel.
newStaticRisks.minimalCheck: Create/cancel 32 real flows against the owned OAuth endpoint, then verify the 33rd start can proceed without waiting 300 seconds.
newStaticRisks.minimalFixDirection: Count active/pending work separately from retained final receipts, or otherwise release waiting capacity without losing truthful poll history.
